title: Ask Before You Optimize: Dynamic Pre-Formulation Clarification for Interactive Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.05258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to formulate optimization models from natural-language problem descriptions, yet realistic operations research (OR) requests are often incomplete: missing objectives, constraints, or business rules can change the resulting mathematical program. Existing evaluations largely assume a complete specification and therefore overlook whether an agent knows when clarification is needed before modeling. We introduce OR-Clarify, a benchmark for pre-formulation clarification. Each task presents a partial public problem description, withholds structured hidden slots, and evaluates agents through bounded interaction with a simulated user. The benchmark supports both openended and choice-based clarification, and measures slot recovery, stopping behavior, silent assumptions, and interaction cost. translated_title: 先提问再优化：面向交互式优化的动态建模前澄清
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于从自然语言问题描述中构建优化模型，但实际运筹学（OR）请求往往是不完整的：缺失的目标、约束或业务规则可能会改变最终得到的数学规划模型。现有评估大多假设规范是完整的，因此忽视了智能体是否知道在建模之前何时需要澄清。我们提出了OR-Clarify，一个用于建模前澄清的基准。每个任务提供一个部分公开的问题描述，隐藏结构化的隐藏槽位，并通过与模拟用户的有限次交互来评估智能体。该基准同时支持开放式和基于选项的澄清方式，并衡量槽位恢复、停止行为、隐性假设和交互成本。我们进一步提出了交互式优化框架InterOPT，这是一个两阶段框架，用于识别未解决的
tldr: 该论文提出了OR-Clarify基准，用于评估大语言模型智能体在面对不完整的运筹学问题时能否在建模前主动识别并向用户澄清缺失信息，并进一步提出两阶段的交互式优化框架InterOPT。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces OR-Clarify, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents know when to seek clarification before formulating optimization models from incomplete requests, and proposes InterOPT, a two-stage interactive optimization framework.
